headline: Dow Jones Industrial Average Falls Sharply as Geopolitical Tensions Over Iran War Weigh on Markets
summary: The Dow Jones Industrial Average closed lower on Tuesday, shedding more than 400 points. Volatility stayed elevated amid the escalating conflict involving Israel and Iran.
why: The Dow Jones Industrial Average tracks 30 large US companies and is a widely watched barometer of US equity market sentiment.

impacts.name: Dow Jones Industrial Average
impacts.why: The index closed more than 400 points lower amid persistent volatility from the Iran conflict.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
